name: double-arm-circles-battle-ropes
instructions:
1. Setup in a good athletic base position with your knees slightly bent, feet shoulder width apart, and both hands holding a rope.
2. Complete arm circles at the shoulder while keeping a soft bend in the knees.
3. Utilize the arms to generate the force and absorb the impact with your legs.
4. Repeat for the desired time, duration, or reps.
